attributes.title: Cluster resource report: capacity
attributes.description: Tiles, capacity by requests with N+1, per cluster, from OpenTelemetry metrics. Generated by kibana/build_dashboard.py in cluster-resource-allocation.

Control-plane nodes and the pods on them are left out (the filter above the panels). Projects show their ID; regenerate with `--rancher-projects` for names and System projects. Docs: `guides/kibana-dashboard.md`.

Dashboards: **Cluster resource report: capacity** · [Cluster resource report: projects](#/view/cra-cluster-resource-projects) · [Project owner: my Project on every cluster](#/view/cra-project-owner) · [Workload limits: limit ≤ 2× request](#/view/cra-workload-limits) · [Will it fit? New deployment vs. cluster capacity](#/view/cra-deployment-fit)"}, "data": {"aggs": [], "searchSource": {}}}, "hidePanelTitles": true, "enhancements": {}}}, {"type": "lens", "gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 4, "w": 36, "h": 5, "i": "p1"}, "panelIndex": "p1", "embeddableConfig": {"attributes": {"title": "Capacity and requests", "visualizationType": "lnsMetric", "type": "lens", "references": [], "state": {"datasourceStates": {"textBased": {"layers": {"layer_0": {"index": "cra-otel-metrics-esql", "query": {"esql": "FROM metrics-*.otel-*
| WHERE metrics.k8s.node.allocatable_cpu IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.node.allocatable_memory IS NOT NULL
     OR metrics.k8s.container.cpu_request IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.container.memory_request IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.container.cpu_limit IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.container.memory_limit IS NOT NULL
     OR metrics.k8s.pod.cpu.usage IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.pod.memory.working_set IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.pod.phase IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.container.restarts IS NOT NULL
     OR metrics.k8s.resource_quota.hard_limit IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.hpa.max_replicas IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.namespace.phase IS NOT NULL
| EVAL cluster = COALESCE(resource.attributes.k8s.cluster.name, "(unknown)"), project = COALESCE(resource.attributes.rancher.project.id, "(no project)"), namespace = COALESCE(resource.attributes.k8s.namespace.name, ""),
       entity = COALESCE(resource.attributes.k8s.pod.uid, resource.attributes.k8s.resourcequota.uid, resource.attributes.k8s.hpa.uid, resource.attributes.k8s.namespace.uid, resource.attributes.k8s.node.name), container = COALESCE(resource.attributes.k8s.container.name, ""),

       ns_now = CASE(recent AND metrics.k8s.namespace.phase IS NOT NULL, 1)

| EVAL is_c = CASE(c_now == 1 AND container != "", 1, 0),

       any_set = CASE(container != "" AND COALESCE(req_cpu, req_mem, lim_cpu, lim_mem) IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)

        lim_mem = SUM(lim_mem), use_cpu = SUM(use_cpu), use_mem = SUM(use_mem), phase = MAX(phase),
        phase_now = MAX(phase_now), containers = SUM(is_c), no_cpu = SUM(no_cpu), no_mem_lim = SUM(no_mem_lim),
        any_set = MAX(any_set), rq = MAX(rq_now), hpa = MAX(hpa_now), ns_now = MAX(ns_now)

       run = CASE(phase == 1 OR phase >= 3, 0.0, 1.0)

        rc_t = SUM(rc_t), rm_t = SUM(rm_t), rc_s = SUM(rc_s), rm_s = SUM(rm_s), rc_u = SUM(rc_u), rm_u = SUM(rm_u),
        use_cpu = SUM(use_cpu), use_mem = SUM(use_mem), pend_cpu = SUM(pend_cpu), pend_mem = SUM(pend_mem),
        containers = SUM(containers), no_cpu = SUM(no_cpu), no_mem_lim = SUM(no_mem_lim),
        ns_u = COUNT_DISTINCT(ns_u)

        no_mem_lim = MAX(no_mem_lim), ns_u = MAX(ns_u)
  BY cluster
| EVAL room_cpu = GREATEST(alloc_cpu - largest_cpu - rc_s, 0), room_mem = GREATEST(alloc_mem - largest_mem - rm_s, 0)
| STATS v0 = COUNT(*), v1 = SUM(nodes), v2 = ROUND(SUM(alloc_cpu), 1), v3 = ROUND(SUM(alloc_mem) / 1073741824.0, 1), v4 = ROUND(SUM(rc), 1), v5 = ROUND(SUM(rm) / 1073741824.0, 1)
| EVAL label = ["Clusters", "Nodes", "Allocatable vCPU", "Allocatable GiB", "Requested vCPU", "Requested GiB"]
| MV_EXPAND label
| EVAL value = CASE(label == "Clusters", TO_DOUBLE(v0), label == "Nodes", TO_DOUBLE(v1), label == "Allocatable vCPU", TO_DOUBLE(v2), label == "Allocatable GiB", TO_DOUBLE(v3), label == "Requested vCPU", TO_DOUBLE(v4), label == "Requested GiB", TO_DOUBLE(v5)), ord = CASE(label == "Clusters", 0, label == "Nodes", 1, label == "Allocatable vCPU", 2, label == "Allocatable GiB", 3, label == "Requested vCPU", 4, label == "Requested GiB", 5)
| SORT ord
| KEEP label, value

attributes.description: Every workload checked against a LimitRange maxLimitRequestRatio of 2, from OpenTelemetry metrics. Generated by kibana/build_dashboard.py in cluster-resource-allocation.

Kubernetes would reject its next pod (restart, rollout, scale-up, drain) when a container has a limit above 2× its request, or a request without a limit (unless the LimitRange sets a default limit); a limit without a request passes (the request becomes the limit). Problems first; *CPU* only matters if the ratio is set for CPU too. Control-plane nodes and the pods on them are left out (the filter above the panels). Projects show their ID; regenerate with `--rancher-projects` for names and System projects.

attributes.title: Will it fit? New deployment vs. cluster capacity
attributes.description: Does a new deployment (replicas x CPU and memory per replica) fit each cluster: per node, after node failures and by usage, from OpenTelemetry metrics. Generated by kibana/build_dashboard.py in cluster-resource-allocation.
attributes.panelsJSON:
[{"type": "visualization", "gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 48, "h": 7, "i": "p0"}, "panelIndex": "p0", "embeddableConfig": {"savedVis": {"title": "", "description": "", "type": "markdown", "uiState": {}, "params": {"fontSize": 12, "openLinksInNewTab": false, "markdown": "**Will it fit?** Set the new deployment in the controls above (replicas, CPU and memory *request* per replica, one replica per node or any, node failures to survive, ceiling), and pick a cluster or compare all. Requests are those of the last 10 minutes of the range (running pods; pending pods count as demand); usage is the nodes' P95 over the range (default: 24 hours). A cluster **FITS** when all three hold:

1. *now*: enough nodes each have room for a whole replica (CPU **and** memory free by requests: what the scheduler checks);
2. *after node failures*: without the largest nodes it still has room for every replica, and running + pending + new requests stay within the ceiling of what is left (the N+1 rule of the capacity dashboard);
3. *by usage*: the same with each node's usage where it is higher than its requests (pods using more than they request leave less room than the requests say).

Taints, node selectors, affinity, quotas and cordoned nodes are not in the metrics: check those for the target nodes. Control-plane nodes and the pods on them are left out (the filter above the panels). 

Dashboards: [Cluster resource report: capacity](#/view/cra-cluster-resource-report) · [Cluster resource report: projects](#/view/cra-cluster-resource-projects) · [Project owner: my Project on every cluster](#/view/cra-project-owner) · [Workload limits: limit ≤ 2× request](#/view/cra-workload-limits) · **Will it fit? New deployment vs. cluster capacity**"}, "data": {"aggs": [], "searchSource": {}}}, "hidePanelTitles": true, "enhancements": {}}}, {"type": "lens", "gridData": {"x": 0, "y": 7, "w": 48, "h": 5, "i": "p1"}, "panelIndex": "p1", "embeddableConfig": {"attributes": {"title": "Answer", "visualizationType": "lnsMetric", "type": "lens", "references": [], "state": {"datasourceStates": {"textBased": {"layers": {"layer_0": {"index": "cra-otel-metrics-esql", "query": {"esql": "FROM metrics-*.otel-*
| WHERE metrics.k8s.node.allocatable_cpu IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.node.allocatable_memory IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.container.cpu_request IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.container.memory_request IS NOT NULL
     OR metrics.k8s.pod.phase IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.node.cpu.usage IS NOT NULL OR metrics.k8s.node.memory.working_set IS NOT NULL
| EVAL cluster = COALESCE(resource.attributes.k8s.cluster.name, "(unknown)"), node = COALESCE(resource.attributes.k8s.node.name, ""),
       entity = COALESCE(resource.attributes.k8s.pod.uid, resource.attributes.k8s.node.name, ""), container = COALESCE(resource.attributes.k8s.container.name, ""),
       recent = @timestamp >= TO_DATETIME(?_tend) - 10 minutes
| EVAL a_cpu = CASE(recent, metrics.k8s.node.allocatable_cpu), a_mem = CASE(recent, metrics.k8s.node.allocatable_memory), r_cpu = CASE(recent, metrics.k8s.container.cpu_request),
       r_mem = CASE(recent, metrics.k8s.container.memory_request), ph = CASE(recent, metrics.k8s.pod.phase)
| STATS a_cpu = MAX(a_cpu), a_mem = MAX(a_mem), r_cpu = MAX(r_cpu), r_mem = MAX(r_mem), ph = MAX(ph),
        node = MAX(node), u_cpu = AVG(metrics.k8s.node.cpu.usage), u_mem = AVG(metrics.k8s.node.memory.working_set)
  BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 60, ?_tstart, ?_tend), cluster, entity, container
| STATS a_cpu = MAX(a_cpu), a_mem = MAX(a_mem), r_cpu = SUM(r_cpu), r_mem = SUM(r_mem), ph = MAX(ph),
        node = MAX(node), u_cpu = MAX(u_cpu), u_mem = MAX(u_mem)
  BY t, cluster, entity
| EVAL run = CASE(ph == 1 OR ph >= 3, 0.0, 1.0), pend = CASE(ph == 1, 1.0, 0.0)
| EVAL rc = TO_DOUBLE(r_cpu) * run, rm = TO_DOUBLE(r_mem) * run, pc = TO_DOUBLE(r_cpu) * pend,
       pm = TO_DOUBLE(r_mem) * pend, node = CASE(pend == 1.0, "", node)
| STATS a_cpu = MAX(a_cpu), a_mem = MAX(a_mem), rc = SUM(rc), rm = SUM(rm), pc = SUM(pc), pm = SUM(pm),
        u_cpu = MAX(u_cpu), u_mem = MAX(u_mem)
  BY t, cluster, node
| STATS a_cpu = MAX(a_cpu), a_mem = MAX(a_mem), rc = MAX(rc), rm = MAX(rm), pc = MAX(pc), pm = MAX(pm),
        uc = PERCENTILE(u_cpu, 95), um = PERCENTILE(u_mem, 95)
  BY cluster, node
| EVAL rc = COALESCE(rc, 0.0), rm = COALESCE(rm, 0.0), pc = COALESCE(pc, 0.0), pm = COALESCE(pm, 0.0),
       uc = COALESCE(uc, 0.0), um = COALESCE(um, 0.0)
| EVAL replicas = TO_DOUBLE(?replicas), c = TO_DOUBLE(?cpu), m = TO_DOUBLE(?memory) * 1073741824.0,
       fails = TO_INTEGER(?failures), ceil = TO_DOUBLE(?ceiling) / 100.0, one = TO_STRING(?spread) == "one per node"
| EVAL fc = a_cpu - rc, fm = a_mem - rm, fcu = a_cpu - GREATEST(rc, uc), fmu = a_mem - GREATEST(rm, um)
| EVAL fit = FLOOR(GREATEST(LEAST(fc / c, fm / m), 0.0) + 0.000001),
       fit_u = FLOOR(GREATEST(LEAST(fcu / c, fmu / m), 0.0) + 0.000001)
| EVAL fit = CASE(one, LEAST(fit, 1.0), fit), fit_u = CASE(one, LEAST(fit_u, 1.0), fit_u)
| STATS nodes = COUNT(a_cpu), a_cpu = SUM(a_cpu), a_mem = SUM(a_mem), rc = SUM(rc), rm = SUM(rm), pc = SUM(pc),
        pm = SUM(pm), uc = SUM(uc), um = SUM(um), top_cpu = TOP(a_cpu, 2, "desc"), top_mem = TOP(a_mem, 2, "desc"),
        fit = SUM(fit), fit_u = SUM(fit_u), top_fit = TOP(fit, 2, "desc"), top_fit_u = TOP(fit_u, 2, "desc"),
        max_fc = MAX(fc), max_fm = MAX(fm)
  BY cluster
| EVAL replicas = TO_DOUBLE(?replicas), c = TO_DOUBLE(?cpu), m = TO_DOUBLE(?memory) * 1073741824.0,
       fails = TO_INTEGER(?failures), ceil = TO_DOUBLE(?ceiling) / 100.0, one = TO_STRING(?spread) == "one per node"
| EVAL need_cpu = replicas * c, need_mem = replicas * m,
       cap_cpu = (a_cpu - COALESCE(CASE(fails <= 0, 0.0, fails == 1, MV_MAX(top_cpu), MV_SUM(top_cpu)), 0.0)) * ceil, cap_mem = (a_mem - COALESCE(CASE(fails <= 0, 0.0, fails == 1, MV_MAX(top_mem), MV_SUM(top_mem)), 0.0)) * ceil,
       fit_f = GREATEST(fit - COALESCE(CASE(fails <= 0, 0.0, fails == 1, MV_MAX(top_fit), MV_SUM(top_fit)), 0.0), 0.0), fit_uf = GREATEST(fit_u - COALESCE(CASE(fails <= 0, 0.0, fails == 1, MV_MAX(top_fit_u), MV_SUM(top_fit_u)), 0.0), 0.0)
| EVAL left_cpu = cap_cpu - rc - pc - need_cpu, left_mem = cap_mem - rm - pm - need_mem,
       left_cpu_u = cap_cpu - GREATEST(rc, uc) - pc - need_cpu, left_mem_u = cap_mem - GREATEST(rm, um) - pm - need_mem
| EVAL ok_now = fit >= replicas, ok_fail = fit_f >= replicas AND left_cpu >= 0 AND left_mem >= 0,
       ok_use = fit_uf >= replicas AND left_cpu_u >= 0 AND left_mem_u >= 0
| EVAL verdict = CASE(ok_now AND ok_fail AND ok_use, "FITS",
                      ok_now AND ok_fail, "fits by requests, tight by usage",
                      ok_now, CONCAT("fits now, not N+", TO_STRING(fails), " / ceiling"),
                      "DOES NOT FIT")
| STATS v0 = COUNT(CASE(verdict == "FITS", 1)), v1 = COUNT(CASE(verdict == "fits by requests, tight by usage", 1)), v2 = COUNT(CASE(verdict != "FITS" AND verdict != "fits by requests, tight by usage", 1)), v3 = ROUND(MAX(need_cpu), 2), v4 = ROUND(MAX(need_mem) / 1073741824.0, 2)
| EVAL label = ["Fits", "Fits by requests only", "Does not fit", "Needed vCPU", "Needed GiB"]
| MV_EXPAND label
| EVAL value = CASE(label == "Fits", TO_DOUBLE(v0), label == "Fits by requests only", TO_DOUBLE(v1), label == "Does not fit", TO_DOUBLE(v2), label == "Needed vCPU", TO_DOUBLE(v3), label == "Needed GiB", TO_DOUBLE(v4)), ord = CASE(label == "Fits", 0, label == "Fits by requests only", 1, label == "Does not fit", 2, label == "Needed vCPU", 3, label == "Needed GiB", 4)
| SORT ord
| KEEP label, value
| RENAME value AS `clusters · needed for all replicas`"}, "timeField": "@timestamp", "columns": [{"columnId": "label", "fieldName": "label", "meta": {"type": "string"}}, {"columnId": "value", "fieldName": "clusters · needed for all replicas", "meta": {"type": "number"}}], "allColumns": [{"columnId": "label", "fieldName": "label", "meta": {"type": "string"}}, {"columnId": "value", "fieldName": "clusters · needed for all replicas", "meta": {"type": "number"}}]}}}}, "internalReferences": [], "filters": [], "query": {"esql": "FROM metrics-*.otel-*
